summary.scope_note: Read-only baseline checks; results require analyst review and are not a compliance certification.

findings.name: Platform Context
findings.recommendation: Review operating-system patching and hardening through the platform's approved management process.

findings.name: Local Service Exposure
findings.detail: No listening services were detected on the reviewed localhost ports.
findings.recommendation: Continue periodic service and firewall review. This check covers only a small predefined port list.

findings.name: Environment Variable Secret Indicators
findings.detail: Variable names that may contain secrets: EXAMPLE_API_KEY. Values were not collected.
findings.recommendation: Confirm sensitive values are managed according to the environment's secrets-management policy and are not exposed in logs or source control.

findings.name: Python Runtime Baseline
findings.detail: Running Python 3.12.6; project minimum is Python 3.10.
findings.recommendation: Keep the interpreter patched and follow the Python project's published support lifecycle.

findings.name: Temporary File Review
findings.detail: No configured high-signal sensitive file types were found in the first 84 temporary files reviewed.
findings.recommendation: Continue protecting temporary storage. This check is intentionally shallow and does not inspect file contents.
